record.issue_text: spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:9 — "is 404 without an embed_url" actually 403s in the before_filter on blank embeddable_host, so `params.require` is never reached and the assertion passes for the wrong reason

adjudication.rationale: EmbedController has `before_filter :ensure_embeddable`, and `ensure_embeddable` raises if `SiteSetting.embeddable_host.blank?` (default in `site_settings.yml` is ''), before the `best` action runs `params.require(:embed_url)`. The spec `it "is 404 without an embed_url" do; get :best; response.should_not be_success; end` never stubs `embeddable_host`, so it can fail due to the before_filter (and also referer checks) rather than missing `embed_url`, making the test name/intent misleading even though the assertion passes.
